description: Keeps this MacBook awake with the lid closed, for a number of whole hours or without a time limit, through the Keep Mac Awake app. Use it before a long task the user asked for, with hours a little longer than the task. Ask the user first and pass user_agreed for a session without a time limit, or when keep_awake_status shows the trial has not started. During the free trial a session lasts at most 8 hours.

hours.description: Length of the session in whole hours, 1 to 168. Leave it out only with no_time_limit.

no_time_limit.description: True for a session without a time limit. Only after the user agreed to it; needs user_agreed.

user_agreed.description: True only when the user said yes to this session in this conversation.

name: keep_awake_start
title: Start a Keep Mac Awake session
